The executable scope topology suites cover these public contract classes:

flexible-layout transparent-folder deep-ancestry marker-preservation
lifecycle move redirect former-path generated-artifact
unsupported-activation dismissed-candidate unicode-collision case-collision
control-path reserved-path hardlink symlink-swap canvas-id-collision
base-formula-order scoped-isolation

This manifest is guardrail input, not a substitute for the assertions in
test_scope_topology.js and test_scope_topology_failures.js.
